exposure: BC15 group: 2 ml bupivacaine + 15 µg clonidine
BC30 group: 2 ml bupivacaine + 30 µg clonidine
BC60 group: 2 ml bupivacaine + 60 µg clonidine
outcome: Onset and duration of sensory and motor block
cohort: 105 ASA I and II patients aged 20-35 years undergoing elective cesarean section
finding: Adding 60 µg of clonidine to intrathecal bupivacaine provided longer postoperative analgesia but also increased sedation compared to 15 µg and 30 µg doses.
